deep.reconstruction:
OVERALL. The page carries the heading 'forma'. It has seven blocks, each multiplied by a linear factor (x-n), plus a short sketch. Its purpose is not stated. The previous page deals with cubic periods / cyclotomy, and the next page is a tailor's list, so neither explains it.

THE CYCLE. The letters a,b,c,...,i,k,...,v (no j) are 21 symbols arranged in a cycle: ...u, v, a, b, c, d, .... A two-letter symbol such as bc, cd or va denotes the pair of neighbours (an edge, or possibly a literal product).

SPECIAL VERTICES. Seven vertices are marked with a superscript zero: c, e, i, l, p, s, u. They cut the 21-cycle into seven arcs:
- c->e, factor (x-4)
- e->i, factor (x-6)
- i->l, factor (x-10)
- l->p, factor (x-12)
- p->s, factor (x-16)
- s->u, factor (x-19)
- u->(v,a,b)->c, factor (x-21)

The numbers 4, 6, 10, 12, 16, 19, 21 are cumulative arc positions. Their successive differences 2, 4, 2, 4, 3, 2, 4 are exactly the numbers of edges in the arcs (c-d-e = 2, e-f-g-h-i = 4, i-k-l = 2, l-m-n-o-p = 4, p-q-r-s = 3, s-t-u = 2, u-v-a-b-c = 4). These sum to 21 (my check).

THE GENERAL BLOCK. For an arc P -> X1 -> ... -> Xr -> Q, where O precedes P and S follows Q, the bracket is:
- P'(P - OP) + P°(P X1 - OP)
- + sum over interior vertices X (neighbours W, Y) of [X'(WX - X) + X''(XY - X)]
- + Q°(Xr Q - QS) + Q''(Q - QS)

To this Gauss adds (Q - P)·i. The factor i is apparently a separate symbol, distinct from the vertex letter i.

VARIABLES PER VERTEX. Each ordinary vertex carries two variables, X' and X''. A special vertex carries P' and P° in the arc it starts, and P° and P'' in the arc it ends. Thus P° occurs twice, with opposite signs of the same difference.

THE WHOLE EXPRESSION (my reading). Implicitly F(x) = sum over k of (x - n_k)[B_k + (Q_k - P_k) i]. Consequences:
- (i) The i-terms telescope: sum of (Q_k - P_k) = 0. So the x-coefficient of the i-part vanishes, and the constant part is -sum n_k (Q_k - P_k).
- (ii) The P° terms cancel in the x-coefficient. Their total contribution is (OP·... difference) times (length of the preceding arc). For example, e°: (x-4)(de-ef) + (x-6)(ef-de) = 2(de-ef).

Every block on the page follows the template exactly. The intended application is uncertain. Possible readings include a period/cycle of forms (suggested by 'forma'), a discrete integral along a closed 21-gon, or a combinatorial-topological chain computation.

SKETCH. At the bottom is a triangle with vertices α, β, γ and a dotted line from γ to the side αβ (a height or cevian). It is unconnected to the formulas.

The arc lengths 2,4,2,4,3,2,4 implied by the x-shifts sum to the cycle length 21 (number of letters a..v without j).
